title: Saturday Night Fever
tagline: Strut in. Fold your slice. Strut out.
about: A Brooklyn paint shop worker lives for Saturday nights on the local disco floor.
cue: Serve the slices as Tony struts down 86th Street to Stayin' Alive.
faces: Contest night. The floor lights at 11.
Whisky, lemon and sugar, topped with lemonade and soda.
Tequila, orange juice, grenadine sunk to the bottom.
Vodka and fresh orange juice, tall, over ice.
Cold by the glass. A pitcher for the crew, 3.50.
The Verrazano. Ten minutes from the floor.
Grilled Italian sausage in bites, soft sweet peppers and onion, a splash of red wine vinegar.
Crisp-cut potatoes under hot beef gravy and melted mozzarella. For after the last dance.
Thin New York pie, tomato, oregano and mozzarella. Stack, fold, strut down 86th Street.
Pizza dough tied and baked, rolled in garlic oil, parsley and grated cheese.
Butter cake rolled with cream cheese, dipped in white chocolate and silver dragées, on a stick.
Two slices, one fizz, then the floor. That’s Saturday.
